title: Brother Freddie Keppard and the first instruments
summary: Keppard names his brother Freddie, one year younger, and says he himself started on guitar while Freddie began on violin with Mr. Baboy.

story.theme_name: Growing up and learning music: family, first instruments, teachers
story.community_name: Where I came from: parents, siblings and birth

blocks.x: Did your parents play any musical instruments?
I started my brother, Freddie Kepler.
What did your brother start on? Was he older or younger than you? Oh, he's younger than me. One year younger than me. He was born...

He was born in... I was born in 1888. He was born in 1889. Remember the date of his birthday? On the... On the 15th of June. And I was born on February 2nd, 1889. 1888. 1888. And what was your first instrument? When did you start? The first instrument was the guitar. And when I was playing guitar, I was nothing but a kid, about 30, 40 years old. And we were ready to start with madeleine. And after he put out madeleine, he asked my dad and my mother to get them a violin. So he started learning violin from Mr. Baboy, an old cripple fellow. And he learned him how to play violin. And after he started playing violin, he got so that he started playing with Mr. Teton. They called him Teton, but his name is Adolf Alexander. And he was playing violin under Teton. As I was saying, his name is Adolf Alexander.
